rationale: Build, blood pressure, lipids, A1c, family history, occupation, avocation and driving all carry zero debits, and total cover sits well inside the 25x income multiple. Two charges apply: tobacco quit within the last five years (25) and liver enzymes elevated above twice normal (25), which is a clear elevation rather than borderline, so the table applies without referral.
